overview: The Contemporary is a Deluxe resort in a modern A-frame tower, with the monorail running right through its lobby. It's the closest hotel to Magic Kingdom, just a short walk away.
suits: Families and Magic Kingdom fans who want the shortest trip to the park.
rooms: Tower rooms have the best views of Magic Kingdom or Bay Lake. Garden Wing rooms are in a separate building and cost less.
pools: The main pool has a waterslide and a splash area, and a second pool sits by Bay Lake.
dining: California Grill, on the top floor, is the signature restaurant with views of the fireworks. Chef Mickey's is a character meal, and Steakhouse 71 and Contempo Cafe round out the options.
pros: Fireworks views from the tower and California Grill
cons: The lobby can be busy and loud
Garden Wing rooms miss the tower's atmosphere
tips: Walk to Magic Kingdom instead of waiting for the monorail; it's often faster.
Book a dinner at California Grill timed with the fireworks.
